mission_identity.continuity_rule: All engineering, scientific, epistemic, acquisition, mathematical, statistical, predictive, dynamic, warning and prevention work belongs to one continuous mission.

purpose: Build, audit, integrate, validate and continuously extend a scientifically governed CeutIA + SERPIENTE system for evidence-grounded territorial knowledge and dynamic risk intelligence, without confusing implementation with empirical validity.

scope.extension_rule: New scientifically justified domains become part of this mission; they do not create a new mission.

architecture.ceutia: source -> document -> observation -> claim -> evidence -> corroboration/contradiction -> provenance -> confidence -> decision context
architecture.serpiente: state -> dynamics -> interaction -> prediction -> uncertainty -> risk -> warning
architecture.integration: Integrated system with explicit scientific separation of epistemic/evidence functions and dynamic/predictive functions.
architecture.causal_boundary: Prediction is not causation; descriptive propagation is not causal propagation.

scientific_principles: absence of evidence != evidence of absence

current_state.DATA_STATUS: Core temporal/provenance/PIT structures are present; continuous live acquisition of all relevant Ceuta sources is not established.
current_state.VALIDATION_STATUS: Engineering and methodological testing established; prospective target-population validation remains external.
current_state.OPERATIONAL_STATUS: Core traceability/decision infrastructure exists; continuous real-world effectiveness is not established.
current_state.EVIDENCE_STATUS: Epistemic/provenance controls exist; empirical prospective claims require external evidence.

second_order_findings: outcome ascertainment as a data-generating process
material_repairs_recorded: prediction payload mutation before outcome scoring

current_capabilities.causal_governance: IMPLEMENTED_AND_TESTED_AS_GOVERNANCE; causal empirical validity not established

limitations.SL01_PIT: PARTIALLY_RESOLVED; hidden upstream preprocessing outside declared lineage cannot be disproved by repository controls alone.
limitations.SL02_future_derived_features: PARTIALLY_RESOLVED; undisclosed external transformation/backdated metadata cannot be ruled out without complete production lineage.
limitations.SL03_baseline: PARTIALLY_RESOLVED; prospective superiority requires future held-out observations.
limitations.SL04_dependence: PARTIALLY_RESOLVED; correct independent unit is process/study-specific.
limitations.SL05_intervention: PARTIALLY_RESOLVED; intervention-effect evidence requires real exposure/assignment/outcome data.
limitations.SL06_response_effectiveness: PARTIALLY_RESOLVED; real operational response/outcome observations required.
limitations.SL09_causal_propagation: PARTIALLY_RESOLVED; specific mechanisms require empirical evidence.
limitations.repository_unknowns: Any state not verified from repository code, tests, CI, Git history or authoritative documentation must be marked UNKNOWN rather than inferred.

temporal_model.information_boundary: I_t = legitimately available information at forecast origin t
temporal_model.computational_representation: X_t = declared computational representation of I_t
temporal_model.rule: Observation-order lags and physical-time lags are distinct and must not be conflated.

spatial_model.status: KNOWN_CONCEPTUALLY; target-specific operationalization depends on registered spatial units and data.

forecasting.principle: Forecasts are conditional on information set, model state/version, target definition and horizon.
forecasting.advanced_methods: Candidate families require target phenomenon, data-generating process, estimand, identifiability, assumptions and validation design before implementation.

uncertainty.rule: Distinct uncertainty sources must not be silently collapsed into a single numerical quantity.

early_warning.chain: signal -> anomaly/change status -> trajectory context -> evidence -> provenance -> uncertainty -> horizon -> severity -> warning

prevention.chain: prediction -> warning -> decision support -> feasible response -> action/no action -> outcome -> effectiveness

self_monitoring.validity_message: CURRENT CONDITIONS MAY BE OUTSIDE THE CONDITIONS UNDER WHICH THIS BEHAVIOUR WAS EVALUATED.

acquisition.rule: Never label a source REAL_TIME without verified acquisition behaviour.

evaluation.retrospective: Allowed for engineering/methodological and historical analyses under explicit information-set and outcome constraints.
evaluation.prospective: Required for prospective predictive validity, calibration transport, intervention effectiveness and operational effectiveness claims.
evaluation.dependence_rule: Use declared process/study-specific evaluation units; do not silently assume row independence.

governance.claim_boundary: A green CI proves the tested engineering state, not scientific truth in the external world.
governance.external_evidence: External evidence requirements remain active dependencies and do not terminate the mission.
governance.unknown_rule: UNKNOWN is a valid state and must be preserved when repository evidence is insufficient.

testing.adversarial: Implemented for key PIT, temporal, provenance, probability, transaction, outcome, causal and cross-repo invariants.

ci_evidence.pit_workflow: 35070241485 FAILURE; retained as historical negative evidence, not positive validation

bibliography_map.rule: Do not invent citations. The authoritative bibliographic mapping is whatever references are actually present in repository scientific documentation and source lineage; missing mapping remains UNKNOWN until verified.
bibliography_map.admission_rule: A method is not implemented merely because it is known; it must pass scientific need -> phenomenon -> data -> identifiability -> assumptions -> implementability -> testability -> incremental value.

open_frontiers.name: scientific information-set contract
open_frontiers.constraint: Must be connected to existing PIT/provenance contracts without duplicating them.

open_frontiers.name: source-process intelligence
open_frontiers.constraint: Requires concrete source adapters and historical process metadata.

open_frontiers.name: interaction drift
open_frontiers.constraint: Requires registered variables, sampling and interaction estimand.

open_frontiers.name: emergent joint anomaly
open_frontiers.constraint: Requires registered multisystem state and reference distribution.

open_frontiers.name: change-point/regime detection
open_frontiers.constraint: Method depends on signal, sampling and loss function.

open_frontiers.name: incremental predictive value
open_frontiers.constraint: Requires baseline/augmented target and registered outcome.

open_frontiers.name: value of information
open_frontiers.constraint: Requires decision, utility/loss, candidate acquisition and uncertainty model.

mission_complete_only_when: reasonably implementable central capabilities are exhausted
relevant sources are integrated or explicitly classified
relevant mathematics/statistics are audited for the actual phenomena
interactions and system-of-systems are sufficiently explored
no central scientifically justified implementable capability remains undiscovered

replication.integrity_rule: A new instance must verify the current Git state and authoritative files before trusting persisted status.
replication.continuation_rule: Load state -> verify -> reconcile code/tests/docs -> identify highest-centrality unfinished capability -> continue mission.
